text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English.
zh: 大家好,欢迎收听《Real Easy English》。
zh_hant: 大家好,歡迎收聽《Real Easy English》。

text: In this podcast, we have real conversations
zh: 在这个播客中,我们有真实的对话
zh_hant: 在這個播客中,我們有真實的對話

text: in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 用简单的英语来帮助你学习。
zh_hant: 用簡單的英語來幫助你學習。

text: I'm Georgie.
And I'm Beth.
You can find a video of this podcast and a worksheet
zh: 你可以找到这期播客的视频和一份练习题
zh_hant: 你可以找到這期播客的影片和一份練習題

text: to help you practice what you've learnt
on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
How are you today, Beth?
I'm very well, thank you.
How are you?
Yes, I'm pretty good, thank you.
Good.
So, what are we talking about today?
zh: 那么,我们今天要聊什么?
zh_hant: 那麼,我們今天要聊什麼?

text: Well, Beth, today we are talking about places.
zh: 好的,贝丝,今天我们来聊聊各种地方。
zh_hant: 好的,貝絲,今天我們來聊聊各種地方。

text: We'll talk about the city and the countryside
zh: 我们将谈谈城市和乡村。
zh_hant: 我們將談談城市和鄉村。

text: and which we prefer.
Very nice.
OK, let's start then.
So, Georgie,
if you were going to visit somewhere, for example,
zh: 如果你打算去某个地方旅游,举个例子,
zh_hant: 如果你打算去某個地方旅遊,舉個例子,

text: would you prefer to visit the city or the countryside ?
zh: 你更喜欢去城市还是乡村?
zh_hant: 你更喜歡去城市還是鄉村?

text: Are we talking about the UK or going abroad?
zh: 我们说的是英国还是国外?
zh_hant: 我們說的是英國還是國外?

text: Let's start with the UK.
OK.
If I visit somewhere in the UK,
zh: 如果我要去英国的某个地方旅游,
zh_hant: 如果我要去英國的某個地方旅遊,

text: I would usually
want to go to the countryside .
That's because I live in a city.
zh: 那是因为我住在城市里。
zh_hant: 那是因為我住在城市裡。

text: I live in London, but I'm from the countryside ,
zh: 我住在伦敦,但我来自乡下。
zh_hant: 我住在倫敦,但我來自鄉下。

text: so sometimes I crave
zh: 有时候我会很想吃点什么
zh_hant: 有時候我會很想吃點什麼

text: going out into a more rural area
zh: 走向更偏远的乡村地区
zh_hant: 走向更偏遠的鄉村地區

text: where I can see more green space,
zh: 我可以看到更多绿地的地方,
zh_hant: 我可以看到更多綠地的地方,

text: there's more wildlife.
It's almost like you need to escape the, the busy
zh: 感觉就像你需要逃离那种忙碌
zh_hant: 感覺就像你需要逃離那種忙碌

text: hustle and bustle of the city.
Yeah.
D'you know, I completely agree with you.
zh: 你知道吗,我完全同意你的看法。
zh_hant: 你知道嗎,我完全同意你的看法。

text: Cities in the UK are great.
There are some great cities, but I have visited
zh: 我去过一些很棒的城市
zh_hant: 我去過一些很棒的城市

text: quite a lot of them.
And after a while
the cities are all similar.
Whereas the countryside , you can do different activities.
zh: 而在乡村,你可以进行各种不同的活动。
zh_hant: 而在鄉村,你可以進行各種不同的活動。

text: It's really nice to see new places.
zh: 看看新地方真的很不错。
zh_hant: 看看新地方真的很不錯。

text: I, a few years ago,
I went to Kent and I had never been to Kent before because
zh: 因为我以前从没去过肯特郡,所以我去了肯特郡。
zh_hant: 因為我以前從沒去過肯特郡,所以我去了肯特郡。

text: I'm from the north of England and Kent
zh: 我来自英格兰北部和肯特郡。
zh_hant: 我來自英格蘭北部和肯特郡。

text: is in the south,
and it was amazing.
They had different kinds of buildings
zh: 他们有不同种类的建筑。
zh_hant: 他們有不同種類的建築。

text: and like architecture on the farms.
zh: 我也喜欢农场里的建筑。
zh_hant: 我也喜歡農場裡的建築。

text: We don't have those same kind of roofs
zh: 我们没有那种一样的屋顶
zh_hant: 我們沒有那種一樣的屋頂

text: in the farms in the, in the north.
Yeah, I also went to Kent last year.
I did, but I went to the seaside
zh: 我去了,不过我去的是海边
zh_hant: 我去了,不過我去的是海邊

text: because Kent also has a bit of coastline.
zh: 因为肯特郡也有一段海岸线。
zh_hant: 因為肯特郡也有一段海岸線。

text: Yeah.
And yeah, I really enjoyed visiting Kent.
zh: 没错,我真的很喜欢参观肯特郡。
zh_hant: 沒錯,我真的很喜歡參觀肯特郡。

text: And the villages are so like cute
zh: 这些村庄真的太可爱了
zh_hant: 這些村莊真的太可愛了

text: and picturesque , we could say.
What about when you go abroad?
Do you, do you also visit the countryside in other countries?
zh: 你也会去其他国家的乡村旅游吗?
zh_hant: 你也會去其他國家的鄉村旅遊嗎?

text: I have done, but to be honest,
I would normally go to a city if I go abroad,
zh: 如果我出国,通常会去城市。
zh_hant: 如果我出國,通常會去城市。

text: maybe the capital city or maybe a smaller city.
zh: 也许是首都,也许是个较小的城市。
zh_hant: 也許是首都,也許是個較小的城市。

text: But one of the reasons for that, I think,
zh: 我认为,其中一个原因是,
zh_hant: 我認為,其中一個原因是,

text: is the transport.
It's so much easier to get a train or a bus
zh: 坐火车或公共汽车要方便多了
zh_hant: 坐火車或公共汽車要方便多了

text: when you're in a city.
And you'd have to hire a car, I think,
to visit a village or something like that.
zh: 去参观一个村庄之类的地方。
zh_hant: 去參觀一個村莊之類的地方。

text: It's very true.
Usually if you go abroad,
you fly to an airport and the airports are usually closer to the city.
zh: 你飞到机场,而机场通常离市区更近。
zh_hant: 你飛到機場,而機場通常離市區更近。

text: And if you only have a few days in a place,
zh: 如果你在一个地方只待几天,
zh_hant: 如果你在一個地方只待幾天,

text: it's easier to just stay in the city.
It's also, I guess,
easier to do lots
of, like, activities in the city
when you visit and try out
lots of the local restaurants,
everything is closer together so you can do more things.
zh: 所有东西都靠得更近,这样你就能做更多的事情。
zh_hant: 所有東西都靠得更近,這樣你就能做更多的事情。

text: Well, I'm just thinking if you're in the city
zh: 我只是在想,如果你在城里的话
zh_hant: 我只是在想,如果你在城裡的話

text: you can, like, search on your phone
for really good restaurants really easily.
zh: 轻松找到真正好吃的餐厅。
zh_hant: 輕鬆找到真正好吃的餐廳。

text: But if I'm in Italy,
for example, and I don't speak Italian,
zh: 比如说吧,我不会说意大利语,
zh_hant: 比如說吧,我不會說義大利語,

text: it would be really difficult, I think,
for me to find a good restaurant
because I wouldn't know where to go.
zh: 因为我不知道该去哪里。
zh_hant: 因為我不知道該去哪裡。

text: Sometimes it's the locals in the countryside
zh: 有时候是乡下的当地人
zh_hant: 有時候是鄉下的當地人

text: that are able to tell you this.
It might not even be on the internet.
zh: 它甚至可能都不在网上。
zh_hant: 它甚至可能都不在網上。

text: Yep.
That's very true.
And hustle and bustle , the busyness and noise
that you find in the city.
We had picturesque , which means pretty or beautiful.
zh: 我们学过picturesque这个词,意思是漂亮或美丽。
zh_hant: 我們學過picturesque這個詞,意思是漂亮或美麗。

text: We often use this to describe a place.
zh: 我们常用这个词来形容一个地方。
zh_hant: 我們常用這個詞來形容一個地方。

text: And visit , to go somewhere for a short time.
zh: Visit,意思是去某个地方短暂停留。
zh_hant: Visit,意思是去某個地方短暫停留。

text: That's it for this episode
of Real Easy English.
Go to our website to find a worksheet to test what you've learned.
zh: 访问我们的网站,找一份练习题来测试你所学的内容。
zh_hant: 訪問我們的網站,找一份練習題來測試你所學的內容。

text: bbclearningenglish.com And next week we'll be talking about gifts.
zh: bbclearningenglish.com 下周我们将聊聊礼物。
zh_hant: bbclearningenglish.com 下週我們將聊聊禮物。

text: So see you then.
Goodbye.
